summary: Lands spec §7's R8 (curve-surface, 3 eq in 3 unknowns) and R9 (one-chart curve-curve, 2 eq in 2 unknowns) as square C1 residuals over the S2A frozen seam. New kernel/residuals_r89.rs defines the minimal 1-var homogeneous curve leaf BezierLeaf1 (degree/control/chart/carrier; try_new refuses degree 0, mismatched count, non-finite coordinates, non-positive weights), R8System { curve: BezierLeaf1, surface: BezierLeaf } and R9System { chart: ChartId, a: BezierLeaf1, b: BezierLeaf1 }, both implementing the frozen SquareResidualEval seam (arity 3 / arity 2). Eval and Jacobian enclosures are composed as products of per-factor hulls over the joint box through the landed hull kernels (hull_bernstein_1d/2d, bernstein_derivative_1d/2d), outward-rounded CertifiedInterval only: H_k = Cw(t).S_k(u,v) - C_k(t).Sw(u,v) for R8 (k in x,y,z) and H_k = C1w(t).C2_k(r) - C1_k(t).C2w(r) for R9 (k in x,y) - NO division anywhere (N5, weights arrive as the §7.1 value argument) and NO transcendental call (N4). R8 certifies through krawczyk_c1_n3 (IBox3 -> PointCert3, rebuild stamped with ResidualId::R8 through PointCert3::try_new); R9 certifies through krawczyk_c1 (IBox2 -> PointCert, rebuild stamped ResidualId::R9). R9 try_new refuses mismatched charts with RefusalKind::ChartExhausted + RefusalEvidence::Predicate { name: "r9_requires_one_chart" }. Constructors re-run the leaf admission gate (raw pub-field leaves cannot reach a residual), refusing non-finite (NonFinite), degree 0 (ClaimRefuted), non-positive weight (WeightDegenerate), and a transcendental-carrier curve marker (TranscendentalCarrier, Disproven). The eight required integration tests land in tests/kernel_r89.rs. mod.rs registers the module (one doc-commented pub mod line).

notes: JUDGEMENT (recorded): 1-var leaf. Wave-1 landed no 1-var homogeneous leaf (leaf_extract extracts only 2-var BezierLeaf surfaces), so this packet defines the minimal BezierLeaf1 in residuals_r89.rs per Section 1 (degree + homogeneous xyzw control + chart), mirroring BezierLeaf::try_new's discipline. Its public chart field is what makes R9's one-chart discipline enforceable (try_new compares a.chart vs b.chart and refuses with RefusalKind::ChartExhausted + predicate r9_requires_one_chart). Its public carrier field carries the rational-leaves-only admission marker: CurveCarrierKind::Rational is set by try_new; a transcendental-only source is refused at the residual constructors with RefusalKind::TranscendentalCarrier (Disproven). The packet's test note 'construct via CarrierData misuse' has no direct encoding in the landed leaf vocabulary (BezierLeaf/BezierLeaf1 hold numeric nets only, and CarrierData does not enter these signatures), so the marker is exercised by a raw pub-field leaf; the refusal kind itself is the caller-constructible §3.2 spelling and this module is the R8/R9 caller.

JUDGEMENT (recorded): eval composition. The residual systems store the leaves, not materialized trivariate grids: the joint-box eval/jacobian is composed as products of per-factor hulls (Cw over the t-axis times S_k over the (u,v)-rectangle, etc.). The product of supersets of the factor ranges is a superset of the product range, so the composition is a sound outward-rounded enclosure of the cross-multiplied residual and its partials over the box; no division by any weight enclosure ever occurs. A box axis outside a leaf's [0,1] unit domain (or a hull refusal) yields the vacuous unbounded enclosure, so the C1 entry answers Inconclusive rather than an unsound bound (leaf.rs convention).

Fixtures are machine-checked ground truths with exact dyadic roots. R8 regular: the line C(t) = (-1/4 + t, 1/4 + t/2, -1/2 + t) pierces the plane S(u,v) = (u, v, 0) at (t,u,v) = (1/2, 1/4, 1/2), C' = (1, 1/2, 1) not in the tangent plane (det DH = 1); box [0.45,0.55]x[0.2,0.3]x[0.45,0.55] certifies Proven with rho <= RHO_MAX and the rebuilt PointCert3 names ResidualId::R8. R8 tangent: the line C(t) = (t, 1/2, t) lies IN the plane z = x (its tangent plane), det DH = 0 on the contact; the C1 refuses Inconclusive (reason c1_n3_midpoint_jacobian_singular) - a Proven PointCert IS the transversality certificate and this box has none. R9 crossing: two coplanar rational quadratics C1(t) = (2t, 4t(1-t)) and C2(r) = (2r, -1+6r-4r^2) cross at the single dyadic pair (1/2, 1/2) at the point (1,1) with det[C1', -C2'] = -4 != 0; box [0.48,0.52]^2 certifies Proven and the rebuilt PointCert names ResidualId::R9. R9 non-crossing: C2n(r) = (2r, -2+4r-3r^2) never meets C1 (y-gap 2 - t^2 >= 1); over [0.3,0.7]^2 the Krawczyk image is disjoint and the C1 is Disproven (ClaimRefuted, backing Disproven), the S2A backing-table class the packet's ground truth permits.

The seam rebuild is the documented one-line seam: the engine stamps ResidualId::R1 and the tests rebuild the emitted certificate through PointCert3::try_new(ResidualId::R8, cert.box_, cert.rho) / PointCert::try_new(ResidualId::R9, cert.box_, cert.rho).

R9 arity 2 runs through the frozen krawczyk_c1 (the seam's n=2 arm composes the landed formal/bezier_isect.rs square 2x2 discipline); no second 2D engine is forked. R8 arity 3 runs through krawczyk_c1_n3 (BG-KV2-206's frozen additive entry), whose backing table is identical to krawczyk_c1's.
